Load libraries
```{r}
library(CellTFusion)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
source("src/utils.R")
set.seed(123)
```

Load data 
```{r}
counts = read.delim("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/TIPIT_RNA_TPM_134.txt")
clinical = read.delim("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/TIPIT_reponse_134.txt")
```

Processed data (134 patients)
```{r}
counts = counts %>%
  dplyr::select(-GeneID) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = T) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_name")

clinical = clinical %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Batch = as.numeric(counts[1,])) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_ID")
  
counts = counts[-1,rownames(clinical)]
```

Log normalized
```{r}
counts.norm.log = log(counts + 1)
```

Gene sets
```{r}
genesets = readRDS("../output/group_marker_genesets.rds")
tfs = scale(compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm.log))
sig_scores = compute.pathway.activity(t(tfs), gene_sets = genesets)[[2]]
patient_group <- apply(sig_scores, 1, function(x) names(which.max(x)))
clinical$group = patient_group
```

Compute survival analysis --> 12 NA values for PFS_bin are omitted thus 122 patients
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(clinical, "PFS", "PFS_bin", file_name = "Validation_Curie_PFS", 
                                         p.value = 0.05, group_column = "group")
```
